notes: LocoTrack-small clip T=16, N=64, 384x512 NTCHW in [0, 255]. Queries (t,x,y) with t=0 (same layout as CoTracker).
Holoscan ClipBufferOp: keep_first=True, max_len=T (frame0 + last T-1). Do not re-query last xy. Eval scale is not applied.
Holoscan backend onnxrt. Outputs are static (B,N,T,*). 5D sample → 4D + time lerp.
